notes.title: Boot Hill Blaster!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242825/10d46874e96163206aad92af934a9ed330f2a24d.jpg[/img]

Get your trusty blaster ready because Boot Hill Blaster is coming to Steam on November 9th!  Enjoy endless fast-paced arcade action, retro graphics, and an original chiptune soundtrack!

[h1]Story[/h1]

You wake up in a desert cemetery one night. You don't remember how you got here, but something feels wrong about the place.

The ground begins to shake and you suddenly find yourself in a fight for your life against a swarm of deadly monsters.

How long can you survive this night of terror?

http://store.steampowered.com/app/743660/Boot_Hill_Blaster/

notes.title: Kilgazar!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242825/779e865d8a264713114d9150c203a8dea7dd0803.jpg[/img]

Kilgazar's army has captured your village! It's time to take matters into your own hands! Battle your way through hordes of enemies. Learn and use powerful magic spells. Infiltrate the fortress to pass through the gateway to the dark underworld. Can you defeat the demon lord, Kilgazar, and free the land from his grasp?

Kilgazar is a turn-based strategy roguelike that pits you against hordes of enemies. Designed to play like a board game, it features a streamlined interface that makes the game deceptively simple to play while presenting a challenge to players. Blending strategy, planning, and a bit of luck, it takes more than sheer aggression to make it to the end and defeat the demon lord Kilgazar.

Please remember vote for Kilgazar if you'd like to see it on Steam!  Those who have previously purchased copies of the game will get a Steam key on release.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=673184250
